confirmations_requested.ask: Call the Central area chief. Radio at 09:30 says scoop 2 (LH-02) is stopped at C512-04, but CMMS OT-5001 shows it closed 20 min ago as operational. Confirm whether LH-02 is running. Nothing is moved for C512-04 until then.

decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down at E595-06. Radio and CMMS OT-5100 agree on a hydraulic failure of 3-5 h on site, so the loader will not be back in time to matter. E595-06 is the best grade (15.4 g/t, about 0.495 oz/t) and has about 256 t of broken ore left (361 - 105). The Este stockpile is 171/450 t. Este trucks move about 80 t/h, and LH-03 alone mucks about 36 t/h, so Este has truck capacity to spare. Central has 4 trucks (about 90 t/h) and 5 LH514 loaders (about 190 t/h), and its stockpile (264/450 t) will fill within about 2 h. Central is truck-limited, so taking its lowest-grade loader costs almost nothing. That loader is LH-06 at C564-01 (5.8 g/t, a carguio stope, so allowed to lend). Travel is about 0.5 h. At about 43 t/h for roughly 6 h, LH-06 can muck all 256 t, worth about 127 oz. I subtract about 10 oz for the small Central loss, which gives about 115 oz net. LH-08 would cost 1.9 oz/h of development and mucks only about 31 t/h. LH-09 would cost 4.0 oz/h. LH-10 is in preventive maintenance until 11:00. No reserve is activated because no stope has stopped. LH-02 at C512-04 is not touched, per CONFIRM-01, because radio and CMMS disagree.
